title: EstateAI WebSocket events
description: Server to client only, over /ws. Authenticated by the session cookie; the Origin must be a configured one. A client frame closes the socket. Close codes: 4401 session ended, 4403 client sent a frame, 4408 idle, 4429 too many connections.

Ready.description: Sent once, when events start flowing. Read what came before it over REST.

MessageCreated.description: A Message was saved in a Conversation the account takes part in. Fetch it with GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages?after={last seq held}.
